modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace

plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify

modules.module_title: Repair and maintain the conveyor system

pcs.pc_description: follow safety practices during maintenance activities as per organisational SOP
perform basic health check-up of conveyor system as specified in the maintenance checklist
check the conveyor system parts i.e. conveyor belt, idler, pulley, motor, driving couplings, brake control system etc. for any wear and tear, damage, improper functioning etc.
repair or replace damaged belt joints, belt cuts and damaged portion of conveyor belt as per the requirement
repair or replace damaged components as per the requirement
carry out lubrication of all bearings and maintain lubrication oil level in the all gear boxes
clean the conveyor gallery and walkway, stair cases, hand railings etc. for safe movement
drain water accommodated in the tail end pulley pits to avoid belt slippage
ensure all pulley laggings are in good condition and bunker gates are working properly
assess when the problem is beyond his competence and report the problem to suitably qualified/designated and competent personnel
dispose off waste materials such as failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s policies
conduct trials of the conveyor system and verify that specified parameters are attained with no abnormalities
change the maintenance due/status sticker
record all repairs carried out, time taken and unplanned tasks encountered during the maintenance activities
